You are an expert chemist, your task is to predict the yield of reaction using your experienced chemical yield prediction knowledge.
Please strictly follow the format, no other information can be provided. Given the SMILES string of a Suzuki reaction, the task focuses on predicting reaction yield, specifically whether a reaction is High-yielding (Yes) or Not High-yielding (No), based on the SMILES string representation of each Suzuki reaction. The reactants are separated by '.', which are separated from the product by '>>'. High-yielding reaction means the yield rate of the reaction is above 70. You will be provided with several examples molecules. Please answer with only Yes or No.The Reaction is as follows
Brc1ccc2ncccc2c1.CC#N.CC(=O)O~CC(=O)O~[Pd].CC(C)(C)P(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C.CCc1cccc(CC)c1.Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1B1OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O1.O.O=C([O-])O.[Na+]>>Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1-c1ccc2ncccc2c1You have to output your judge, which is "Yes" or "No", and exactly follow the output format, which is as follows:
{"answer": "The answer you judge"}. I don't need any explanation, you just need to output your judgment in the format.

Please use your tools to analyze and solve this problem accurately.

1. [ ] Identify the Suzuki coupling partners and reaction conditions.
2. [ ] Assess substrate compatibility and likely yield using chemistry evidence.
3. [ ] Return the binary judgment in the required JSON format.

Tool call: go_search_agent
Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 1, 'search_target': 'Assess whether the specified Suzuki coupling is likely high-yielding (>70%). Reactants: 1-bromoquinoline-like fused heteroarene Brc1ccc2ncccc2c1; boronic ester Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1B1OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O1; palladium acetate, bulky triisopropylphosphine, sodium bicarbonate, water, acetonitrile, and ethylbenzene-like additive. Determine likely isolated yield category: above 70% or not.'}
